structured.feedback: The description is about 200 words, uses clear Markdown subheadings and ends with a call to action. It has no links or invented quotes, and it leaves out the slipping and fit complaints. Its claims mostly match the listing, including the 3-pack, different colors, and wearing the band wide or folded. Minor issues: the typo "a effortless", "moisture-wicking" stretches the listing's "Moisture", and the feature-versus-benefit split is blended.
